name: Gao-Qi Rao
evidence: Retrieved via raw.githubusercontent.com. The NLPTEA-2016 CGED dataset README names the copyright holders 'Lung-Hao Lee, Gaoqi Rao, Liang-Chih Yu, Endong Xun, Baolin Zhang, and Li-Ping Chang' and then prints the matching contact list verbatim: 'lhlee@ntnu.edu.tw, raogaoqi@blcu.edu.cn, lcyu@saturn.yzu.edu.tw, edxun@126.com, ...' — the address maps to Rao Gaoqi by surname+given-name order and by the BLCU domain he shares with co-organiser Baolin Zhang. Anchor to THIS person: 'Gao-Qi Rao' / 'Gaoqi Rao' is the Beijing Language and Culture University computational linguist who organised the NLPTEA CGED shared tasks (2016, 2018, 2020) and publishes on Chinese corpora and LLM evaluation; BLCU is the affiliation consistent with the row's cross-cultural LLM benchmark work, and the repo (blcuicall = BLCU ICALL group) is his own group's. No other researcher of this name was found in NLP. Residual namesake risk judged low; note the address is a 2016-vintage institutional one.
